assertions: Thirteen original interface declarations retain complete method types, direct bases and actual normal CPPU ownership.
Eight event field contracts and original FrameAction literal values close the declaration graph without manufactured runtime event or component owners.
gaps: J0Z0KF ports the closed original XModel/XController/XFrame/XFramesSupplier/XFrames model, frame and window listener IDL declaration graph. Thirteen interfaces retain complete method signatures, direct base inheritance and actual cached CPPUMaker-normal Type/Reference ownership over existing shared CPPU factories.
